text:
pagerbot: :rotating_light: PagerDuty alert triggered (PD-98321) — 5xx rate spike on inference-gateway; metric: http.5xx.rate > 150/min for 3m in us-west2; affected routes: /v1/generate, /v1/chat; error sample: `upstream 502` — runbook: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/5xx-spike

alice: acked and taking

alice: I'm oncall-rotator — checking ingress + LB health. Can folks post recent deploys? @carol

bob: seeing concurrent KV cache evictions in traces, KVS reclaim bump at 02:10 UTC

carol: rolled model-gateway v2.14 to canary ~02:05; rollout still ramping to 20%

alice: ok hold rollout: `kubectl -n prod rollout pause deploy/model-gateway`

dave: pushing a quick scale up for inference-gateway: `kubectl -n prod scale deploy/inference-gateway --replicas=8` — doing now

ops-bot: autoscaler scaled from 3 -> 8 replicas

alice: traffic reroute to fallback pool (route weight shift) initiated: `infra route shift --service inference-gateway --to fallback-pool --percent 40` — monitoring

bob: logs from a failed request:
```
ERROR upstream request failed: read tcp 10.3.2.5:443: connection reset by peer
stack: grpc: ClientConn closing
```

carol: looks like canary hosts hitting a pinned upstream that returned 502; probable model process OOM or kernel issue. Suggest revert canary.

alice: rolling back canary: `kubectl -n prod rollout undo deploy/model-gateway --to-revision=27` — started

pagerbot: PagerDuty PD-98321 acknowledged by alice

eve: (next oncall) I'm ready to take over at next handoff; will monitor customer-facing SLOs and coordinate postmortem if needed

alice: short-term mitigation: rollback complete, 5xx rate dropping ~70% in 2m. Keep monitoring 10m before close. :thumbsup:

bob: continuing to stream logs and check KV mem pressure

dave: filing infra ticket for deeper investigation on pinned upstream host 10.3.2.5 — ticket INF-1209

alice: customer impact check: spike mostly affected chat generation endpoints for a small subset of EU/US customers; no broad outage reported from PG. Notifying CS to watch inbound tickets.

carol: we'll block the faulty model variant from future rollouts until root cause triaged

alice: handing off to eve for next 4h watch — i'll update incident channel and incident tracker. Thanks all.

eve: taking over. will open Ops bridge if spike resurges. :white_check_mark:
